title: NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly
abstract: arXiv:2611.31099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ re-encode the camera images and the instruction with a 2B-parameter backbone at every control step, and the feed-forward layers of this prefix account for most of its compute. A natural way to save this compute is to send most tokens through a low-rank MLP and compute exactly only the tokens whose approximation error is large. We find that this intuition is wrong. Even a verifier that knows every token's exact error picks the wrong tokens, producing 1.3--1.7$\times$ larger action deviation than a simple test of whether a token's input is novel, that is, whether it falls outside the subspace seen during calibration. Large errors concentrate in tokens the policy relies on little, such as the third-person camera, while the novelty test favors the wrist camera, a view the action depends on heavily. We call this the error--reliance gap. Building on it, we propose NoveltyG

translated_title: NoveltyGate：决定VLA前缀Token精确计算的是新颖性，而非误差
translated_abstract: 诸如 π₀.₅ 这类流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在每个控制步都会使用20亿参数的主干网络重新编码相机图像和指令，而该前缀部分的前馈层占据了大部分计算量。节省这部分计算的一种自然方法是让大多数token通过低秩MLP，仅对近似误差较大的token进行精确计算。我们发现这种直觉是错误的：即使是一个知道每个token精确误差的验证器，也会选错token，其产生的动作偏差比一个简单的“判断token输入是否新颖”（即是否落在校准时所见子空间之外）的测试要大1.3--1.7倍。大误差集中在策略依赖较少的token上（如第三人称相机视角），而新颖性测试则倾向于选择腕部相机——一个动作高度依赖的视角。我们将这种现象称为“误差-依赖性鸿沟”（error--reliance gap）。基于此，我们提出了 NoveltyGate……
tldr: 论文发现决定VLA模型前缀token是否需要精确计算的关键因素是token输入的新颖性而非近似误差大小，并提出NoveltyGate利用这一“误差-依赖性鸿沟”实现更高效且更准确的计算分配。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that novelty of token inputs, rather than approximation error, determines which VLA prefix tokens should be computed exactly, and proposes NoveltyGate to exploit this error-reliance gap for more efficient and accurate compute allocation.
